items.label: BUBBLE MACHINE 2-PIECE SET
items.value: This bubble machine includes 2 pieces of bubble wands with extra 2 refills, and 10 bags of bubble concentrate. And 2 colors of bubble blower are provided to match any color

items.label: A FUN GIFT FOR ALL AGES
items.value: Each bubble machine boy toys features 40 holes and lights to create a mesmerizing bubble show. Produces over 5000 bubbles per minute, perfect for outdoor and indoor parties

items.label: SMALL AND LIGHTWEIGHT EASY TO USE
items.value: These bubble machine are compactly constructed and lightweight, perfect for small hands, kids can easily hold. Simply dip the bubble wand into the bubble water, remove and pull the trigger to produce countless bubbles

items.label: SUITABLE FOR MULTIPLE SCENARIOS
items.value: The bubble blower can bring joy to your child and many other children in the park, which is an endless source of fun and laughter

items.label: QUALITY MATERIALS
items.value: The bubble machine is made of quality materials that ensure long-lasting fun for kids of all ages. Its sturdy construction means it can withstand rough play and frequent use

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 10 Bags of Bubble Concentrate, 2 Bottles Bubble Refill Solution, 2 Bubble Machine(not including batteries)
